title: Yonaguni
summary: Yonaguni is an island in Japan, once home to an highly advanced underwater civilisation. It is guarded by the giant Titan, Kyojin, whose own body makes up a part of the city that he guards.
full_text: Yonaguni is an island in Japan, once home to an highly advanced underwater civilisation. It is guarded by the giant Titan, Kyojin, whose own body makes up a part of the city that he guards. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]
